response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_group_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_of_group_size_per_minute FROM g

assumptions.assumption: The text comparison is a plain string comparison on chronotag, as the request states. Rows with NULL chronotag are excluded.
A zero spanmin is treated as missing (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero, so those rows add nothing to the size-per-minute average.
Groups whose averages are NULL (all values missing) are skipped by the outer AVG, which is the usual SQL behaviour for ignoring missing values.
